verdict.rationale: PostHog documents funnel insights built on events you already send, alongside paths and retention, saved to dashboards with alerts (docs-15, docs-25). For a non-analyst founder, PostHog AI is documented as an in-product AI analyst that takes plain-English questions, builds the insight and explains what it found (docs-35, supp-posthog-ai-analyst). The wizard can also generate custom events and dashboards from real product flows (supp-ai-wizard). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-step drop-off/conversion breakdowns, and independent or hands-on corroboration of founders self-serving funnel analysis.
